title: BinaryRowsConnector
description: Reads rows from a Hop binary row file (writeMeta/writeData format)

sourceConnectorName.title: Source connector
sourceConnectorName.description: Upstream connector this transform reads from (if applicable)

cacheOnDisk.title: Cache data on disk?
cacheOnDisk.description: Store connector output as Hop binary rows under the server data path. Reloads only when the connector changes or a full presentation refresh is requested.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Apache Commons VFS path to a .hoprows file (e.g. ${HOPPER_DATA_PATH}/timings/My Presentation/latest.hoprows)

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Max data rows to read (0 = unlimited)
